concept.literalSynthesis: A vampire-spark wand wrapped in the stitched panels of a vampire's coat, its red ember glowing through the seams. It remains a wand in the hand and becomes a wearable stitched accessory when equipped.
concept.coreMechanic: A reusable magic wand fires one cursor-aimed ember at 26.25 blocks/s every 26 ticks, costs 4 mana per native use, and launches with a forward 1-block offset. The ember travels on an authored gravity arc with 27 blocks/s² downward acceleration, lasts up to 1.5 seconds, deals 12 magic damage, and heals its owner for 10% of damage dealt on a hit, capped at 1 HP per hit. Equipping the wand grants 4 defense, +1 HP/s life regeneration, and +5% movement speed. Defense and equipment bonuses apply only while equipped. The parents have generation depth 0; no progression tier is inferred from that fact, their rarity, or value.
concept.parentAContribution: The vampire spark wand contributes its magic identity, 12 damage, 4-mana cost, 26-tick cadence, and gravity-arc ember with on-hit owner healing. Its source projectile used 7 pixels per tick, a 16-pixel forward offset, a 90-tick lifetime, and 0.12 gravity per update; the new runtime expresses those values in its current units.
concept.parentBContribution: The stitched vampire suit contributes the wearable vampire-garment identity and its equipped passive role. The generated accessory gives that role explicit defense and life regeneration, while retaining the source suit's 5% movement-speed bonus; none of these bonuses applies merely from holding the wand.
concept.playerExperience: Use the wand for a deliberate, mana-priced ember shot; hits provide at most 1 HP of healing each. Equip it for a modest defensive and regenerative benefit plus a small speed increase. Its 4 defense is an equipped bonus, not a held bonus.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Fire one cursor-aimed gravity-arc ember for 4 mana; a damaging hit heals up to 1 HP.
Wear the wand as a stitched vampire accessory for 4 defense, +1 HP/s life regeneration, and +5% movement speed.

realization.description: Use the wand to fire one 12-damage magic ember toward the cursor. Each shot costs 4 mana and can heal up to 1 HP when it hits. It travels with a downward gravity arc and expires after 1.5 seconds if it has not already hit an enemy or tile. While equipped, the stitched wand grants 4 defense, 1 HP/s life regeneration, and 5% movement speed.
realization.playerExperience: The wand keeps its source's 26-tick rhythm and mana cost. Healing is tied to actual damaging hits and capped per hit; the accessory bonuses require equipping it.
